g.text: Runs on the user's machine with configured environments.
Missing external tools are reported explicitly.

g.text: Each run keeps final outputs, intermediate files,
workflow JSON, manifests, checksums, and reports.

g.text: Human-in-the-loop architecture of the natural-language research agent

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: The language model plans constrained workflows; experts review key decisions; predefined local skills and command-line tools perform execution.

g.text: Design principle: the LLM proposes; experts approve and interpret; constrained skills and local tools execute.
